Only the medical REGULATOR + its good-standing issuance are profession-specific and sourced here.

regulator.value: Pakistan Medical & Dental Council (PMDC), pmdc.pk — reconstituted from the Pakistan Medical Commission (PMC) by the PMDC Act 2022 (assent Jan 2023); PMDC describes itself as 'Successor of Pakistan Medical Commission'. Older docs/portals may still say PMC.

goodStandingIssuance.value: A PMDC-registered doctor applies for a Certificate of Good Standing (CGS) via PMDC's online 'Other Services' portal (online.pmdc.pk): sign in, complete the CGS form, supply a current PMDC licence/registration, photo, biodata and the receiving regulator's details. PMDC can email the CGS directly to receiving regulators that accept it (e.g. GMC, Irish Medical Council) or post it, and the applicant receives a copy; processing ~2 weeks online. Fee reported ~PKR 4,000–5,000 (confirm on the portal). Note: receiving boards like the GMC accept a CGS issued within the previous 3 months.

regulator.value: The National Medical Commission (NMC), established under the NMC Act 2019, replaced the Medical Council of India on 25 Sep 2020; doctors are on the National Medical Register, with primary registration held at the State Medical Councils (SMCs).

sources.name: National Medical Commission (official)
sources.note: site blocked automated fetch; URL authoritative

goodStandingIssuance.value: A Certificate of Good Standing for an India-registered doctor is obtained via the NMC and/or the State Medical Council of registration: the NMC provides an official application form, and the application is processed through the Registrar of the SMC (which verifies the disciplinary record); many SMCs (e.g. West Bengal, Punjab) also issue the CGS on their own forms. Reported fee ~₹3,100 (varies by council), validity ~6 months; typically forwarded to the receiving authority (applicant supplies the exact official address). Confirm with the relevant NMC/SMC page.

regulator.value: Medical and Dental Council of Nigeria (MDCN), the statutory body for medical/dental registration and licensing; mdcn.gov.ng (portal.mdcn.gov.ng).

goodStandingIssuance.value: A Nigeria-registered doctor obtains a Certificate of Good Standing (CoGS) online via the MDCN portal: log in with folio number, select 'Certificate of Good Standing' under My Application, and supply the exact name and official address of the receiving organisation (not a home address — indicating named-recipient delivery). Requires continuous good standing since graduation; stated processing 10–14 working days. Fee reported ~₦350,000 (+~₦40,000 by destination), raised from ₦115,000 in 2024 — secondary/press-sourced; confirm with MDCN.

regulator.value: Doctors in Egypt register through the Egyptian Medical Syndicate (General Syndicate of Egyptian Doctors / النقابة العامة لأطباء مصر), ems.org.eg; the Syndicate works with the Ministry of Health and Population, which grants the practice licence. The Syndicate issues good-standing/registration proof for going abroad.

sources.name: German state medical authority official CoGS-issuer list — names Egyptian Medical Syndicate for Egypt

goodStandingIssuance.value: The Certificate of Good Standing / good conduct (شهادة حسن سير وسلوك) is obtained from the Egyptian Medical Syndicate (Dar El-Hekma, 42 Kasr El Ainy St, Cairo). The syndicate member requests it and it is issued to the applicant, who submits it to the overseas body; for GMC it must be within 3 months and, if not in English, certified-translated. Exact current fee and in-person vs remote process: confirm with the Syndicate (official site not machine-readable).

regulator.value: Doctors are registered by the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) through its Professional Regulatory Board of Medicine, which issues the Certificate of Registration and PIC after the Physician Licensure Examination.

goodStandingIssuance.value: For an overseas medical regulator, the relevant route is PRC STATEBOARD VERIFICATION / Validation of Registration: complete the Stateboard Verification Slip (from prc.gov.ph), pay P75.00 per copy plus stamps, submit with a copy of the valid PIC and Transcript at Window-C; PRC sends the verification DIRECTLY office-to-office to the requesting overseas authority ('Mailing is strictly an Office-to-Office transaction'). Alternatively, Certification/Authentication is applied for via the LERIS portal (released to the applicant).

regulator.value: Sri Lanka Medical Council (SLMC), the statutory regulator of medical, dental and allied professionals; slmc.gov.lk (No. 31, Norris Canal Road, Colombo 10).

goodStandingIssuance.value: A SLMC-registered doctor obtains a Certificate of Good Standing by submitting the official CGS form + affidavit + bank payment slip. Fee LKR 8,000 (regular, 5 working days) or LKR 10,000 (urgent, 2 working days), paid to Bank of Ceylon Maradana. The form supports naming a verification agency/overseas regulator for DIRECT-to-receiver email forwarding; otherwise issued to the applicant. Contact applications@slmc.gov.lk.
